messages:
tanya_sales: Quick sync  Horizon Financial wants to rip out RivalAPI and migrate to Redwood. They asked for a 2-week POC: API parity, sampling parity, EU-only data, and a pricing comparison. Can we outline next steps?
li_engineer: Proposed minimal plan: 1) create an adapter that accepts Rival payloads, 2) run their canonical prompt bundle through Rival + Redwood, 3) compute parity metrics (intent match, embedding sim, policy agreement), 4) document remediations and sampling knobs.
omar_se: We need their sample Rival request logs + top 30 prompts. Also request their success criteria in writing (e.g., intent >= 95%).
susan_security: They'll send a 30-40pg security questionnaire. Key asks flagged already: SAML SSO, BYOK, EU-only egress, and retention controls. If they require on-prem, add 3-4 weeks.
kyle_ops: For POC infra: suggest scoped Dedicated in eu-west-1 with 2xA100 equiv, cap tokens to 40k/day. Autoscale off initially, enable burst for throughput tests.
harper_legal: Route security docs to legal@redwood.com. If they request data-transfer restrictions we'll need DPA addendum; expect ~7-14 business days for negotiations.
infra-bot: POC workspace created: horizon-poc-2026 (region eu-west-1). Invite sent to tanya_sales.
li_engineer: Quick shim pattern (conceptual): translate Rival POST /v1/respond body {prompt, params, user_id} -> Redwood POST /v1/chat messages array, map params.top_k/top_p/temp, and stream->SSE. Exact output parity not guaranteed; focus on behavioral parity.
li_engineer: Example quick check command for their team to run locally:
```
python parity_check.py --baseline https://api.rival.ai/v1/respond --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat --prompts horizon_prompts.json --out diffs.csv
```
omar_se: Parity metrics proposal: intent binary match >=95%, mean embedding cosine >=0.90, safety-filter agreement >=98%, token-length variance <12%. Flag any safety mismatches as blockers.
susan_security: Also confirm retention window and redaction rules up front. No raw logs shared without signed agreement.
tanya_sales: Action items: 1) Omar/ Li to produce shim + harness prototype by Thu EOD; 2) Ops to provide cost estimate and provision POC infra; 3) Legal/Security to standby for questionnaire. I'll set kickoff for Mon 09:00 CET.
li_engineer: Acknowledged. Will ship dockerized harness and a small shim PR.
harper_legal: I'll block time for review after we get the questionnaire.
tanya_sales: Thanks team, I'll ask Horizon for their prompt set and request Rival sample calls now.
